Supplementary files format and content: Processed data files include two GNU zipped tab-separated values (.tsv.gz) files, one file contains the filtered barcode UMIs (barcodes.tsv.gz) and the second file contains the filtered feature counts (features.tsv.gz), and one GNU zipped matrix (.mtx.gz) file containing the the filtered matrix of barcode UMIs and feature counts.

Supplementary files format and content: Supplementary processed data files include rtx_bcells_annotations.txt.gz (containing meta data for post-quality control total analyzed B cells), and rtx_bcells_umi.txt.gz (containing non-normalised UMI count data for post-quality control total analyzed B cells).

metadata.source_specimen: Live B cells sorted from PBMC during post-rituximab B-cell recovery
metadata.source_coverage_policy: FACS B-cell enrichment restricts lineage coverage; absent non-B lineages remain unavailable. Source sorted identity does not override SCimilarity annotations.
metadata.source_time_policy: Original relapse/remission phase labels retained; no temporal order, elapsed interval, calendar dates or treatment dose inferred.
metadata.source_demographic_policy: Pediatric is a source age category, not a numerical age. Individual ages unavailable; original sex retained.
metadata.source_identity_policy: Original donor-number titles map explicitly to paired INS15..INS18 file labels. Repeated relapse/remission draws are not independent donors. Donor1..4 in companion GSE233275 use different INS1..INS4 labels and opposite sex fields; matching title numbers alone is not a cross-study alias.
metadata.source_alias_policy: GSE233277 is the superseries; its reused records must not be counted again. Broader participant overlap with companion cohorts remains unresolved beyond original codes.
metadata.source_count_policy: Deposited filtered CellRanger3.0.1 UMI matrices, GRCh38 source assembly. Preserve native RNA gene coordinates; no Seurat integration or expression inversion.
metadata.source_missingness_policy: Unknown numerical ages, dates, intervals and unavailable types are not imputed or zero-filled.
metadata.split_assignment: unassigned; preserve both phases per original INS participant together; cross-study identity unresolved

source_count_review.barcode_scope: Source matrix barcode rows; not automatically called or viable cells
